content.text: Oe Cathut, duem awm hanh leih,
lawk tho laipalah duem awm hanh.
Oe Cathut duem awm hanh.
Na tarannaw teh ruengruengti awh.
Nang kahmuhmanaw teh a loungouk awh.
Na taminaw taranlahoi hnephnap hoi kho a khan awh teh,
na hro e na taminaw taran laihoi pouknae a kâoup awh.
Tho awh, miphun lah aonae koehoi raphoe awh sei,
Isarel min hai panue hoeh nahanlah ati awh.
Lungpouk buet touh lah, a kâpan awh teh,
nang taranlahoi lawkkamnae teh a sak awh.
Edom hoi Ishmael rim dawk kaawmnaw,
Moab hoi Hagar,
Gebal hoi Amon, Amalek hoi Filistin,
hoi Taire kaawm e naw hoi lawkkam a sak awh.
Assyria hai ahnimouh koelah a kambawng teh,
Lot catounnaw hah a kabawp. Selah.
Ahnimouh teh Midian koe na sak e patetlah,
Kishion palang vah Sisera koehoi Jabin koe na sak e patetlah,
bout sak pouh haw.
Ahnimouh teh Endor vah a due awh teh,
talai dawk vaipuen lah a coung awh.
A tami kalennaw teh Oreb hoi Zeeb patetlah sak nateh,
Bokheiyah, ahnimae siangpahrang pueng hah
Zeeb hoi Zalmunna patetlah sak haw.
Hotnaw ni Cathut e saring pânae hmuen koehoi,
kamamouh hanlah ka la awh han ati awh.
Oe Cathut ahnimouh teh vaiphu kahlî ni palek e hoi
vaikong kahlî ni a palek e patetlah coung sak haw.
Hmai ni thing a kak e hoi,
mon hah hmai ni a kak e patetlah coung sak haw.
Ahnimouh teh na kahlî kathout hoi pâlei nateh,
puenghoi katang e kahlî hoi pakhi haw.
Oe BAWIPA, na min a tawng awh nahan lah
a minhmai ka paling lah kayak sak ngala haw.
Nang dueng doeh BAWIPA min ka sin e hoi
talai van pueng dawk Lathueng Poung
lah na o e hah na panue thai awh nahanelah,
Yeiraipo hoi rucat hoi pou awm sak haw.
Bokheiyah, kaya hoi awm sak nateh,
koung kahmat naseh.
